character_description: Hecate, liminal goddess with three-fold manifestation—appearing young, mother, and crone simultaneously. Dark hair sometimes crowned with stars, sometimes simple. Eyes that see all times and places simultaneously. She carries torches illuminating hidden truths. Straddles boundaries between worlds.
setting: Crossroads between worlds—life/death, light/dark, known/unknown, divine/mortal
theme: Finding wisdom in liminality and power in boundary-keeping

video_prompts: Hecate stands at cosmic crossroads where all possibilities converge and diverge. She is guardian of transitions.
first_frame_prompt: Hecate manifests at infinite crossroads, her three-fold form visible simultaneously—young maiden, mature mother, wise crone. Dark hair crowned with stars that shift between them. Eyes see all directions at once—past, future, all possibilities. Torches in her hands illuminate pathways few dare to walk. She embodies liminality itself.
speech: I stand at the threshold where all choices converge.
